evals.name: seeded-boundary-violation
evals.prompt:
Constraint card: target fun = Challenge, Sensation; core verb = route; setting = a desert railway with one train a day; twist = every door is one-way; session length = 10 minutes; scope = one month solo.
Boundaries (hard rules): no sexual content; no violence (no combat, killing, gore or weapons as a verb or theme); no real-money gambling.
History: "Signal Box — route trains through a snowy junction".
Seed concept to judge alongside yours: "Rail Raiders — you ride the train and shoot the bandits who board it at each station."
evals.expected_output: At least 6 new concepts, each with a different frame; the seeded Rail Raiders concept is rejected at the boundary gate with a reason naming violence, has no scores, and is never the pick; the pick has the highest total.
expectations: Outputs at least 6 new concepts with distinct frames
Rejects the seeded concept before scoring and records the reason
Does not pick a rejected concept
The pick has the highest total

checks.expr: len([c for c in d['concepts'] if c['frame'] != 'supplied']) >= 6
len(set(c['frame'] for c in d['concepts'] if c['frame'] != 'supplied')) == len([c for c in d['concepts'] if c['frame'] != 'supplied'])
any('raider' in c['title'].lower() and c['rejected_reason'] and c['total'] is None and not c['scores'] for c in d['concepts'])
all(not c['rejected_reason'] for c in d['concepts'] if c['title'] == d['pick'])
max(c['total'] for c in d['concepts'] if c['total'] is not None) == [c['total'] for c in d['concepts'] if c['title'] == d['pick']][0]

all(abs(c['total'] - (0.35*c['scores']['fun_fit'] + 0.25*c['scores']['novelty'] + 0.15*c['scores']['clarity'] + 0.25*c['scores']['prototypability'])) <= 0.011 for c in d['concepts'] if c['total'] is not None)

evals.name: draw-missing-card
evals.prompt: Give me a game idea for tonight. I only know I want Discovery to be one of the target kinds of fun. No boundaries this time. History: "Tide Clerk — catalog shells on tidal flats before the tide returns", "Moon Mail — deliver letters across a moon post office".
evals.expected_output: Draws the missing card fields from the decks and states it under Assumptions, includes Discovery in the target fun, writes at least 6 concepts with distinct frames, notes that no boundaries were supplied, and picks a concept that is not a history entry.
expectations: States under Assumptions that card fields were drawn
Keeps Discovery in the target fun
Does not ask the user a question

checks.description: pick is not a history title

checks.pattern: (would you like|do you want|could you (tell|clarify)|let me know which)

evals.name: gambling-line
evals.prompt:
Constraint card: target fun = Fellowship, Challenge; core verb = trade; setting = a night market that moves every evening; twist = light is the only currency; session length = 20 minutes; scope = three months solo.
Boundaries: no sexual content; no violence; no real-money gambling (playing cards, dice and chance mechanics with fictional currency are fine).
Seed concepts to judge alongside yours:
1. "Lantern Dice — stallholders roll dice for lantern-light, an in-game currency that cannot be bought."
2. "Glow Pass — buy lantern-light crates with real money for a random chance at rare stalls, then cash out rare stalls for gift cards."
evals.expected_output: Glow Pass is rejected for real-money gambling; Lantern Dice passes the gate and is scored, because chance with fictional currency is allowed; at least 6 new concepts.
expectations: Rejects Glow Pass for real-money gambling
Scores Lantern Dice instead of rejecting it

checks.expr: any('glow pass' in c['title'].lower() and c['rejected_reason'] and c['total'] is None for c in d['concepts'])
any('lantern dice' in c['title'].lower() and not c['rejected_reason'] and c['total'] is not None for c in d['concepts'])
len([c for c in d['concepts'] if c['frame'] != 'supplied']) >= 6
len(d['runners_up']) == 2 and all(not c['rejected_reason'] for c in d['concepts'] if c['title'] in d['runners_up'])
